title: Risk accounting basis: units of stored amounts, which positions count as open, how partial sells and gas count, and whether per-chain max capital is a cap

options.name: Keep current accounting
options.risk: The daily-loss breaker misses ordinary losses and the exposure cap turns off after a partial sell (AUD-DB-002); stuck positions free their slots (AUD-DB-003); partial sells are double-charged and currencies are mixed (AUD-DB-013); per-chain max capital is not a cap (AUD-DB-014).

options.name: Store every amount in wei, count open positions by exit lifecycle (incl. exit_failed_held), compute loss per position on cost basis, keep totals per currency; max capital stays a loss base (renamed)
options.behavior_impact: The breaker and the caps start to bind as documented; more snipes are refused after losses or while positions are stuck.
options.risk: A data migration of existing buy rows (decimal to wei); the dashboard P&L changes.

options.name: As wei-and-lifecycle, plus enforce deployed-per-chain <= <PREFIX>_MAX_CAPITAL in canSnipe
options.behavior_impact: Adds a per-chain deployment cap that matches the .env.example wording.
options.risk: One more limit that can refuse snipes; needs per-chain cost basis.

recommendation: wei-and-lifecycle as the minimum, because without it the configured limits do not measure what they claim; add the per-chain cap only if the operator wants that limit.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides what the daily-loss breaker, the exposure cap and the open-position limit actually count.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion before Wave A (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
